title: Life is a slime mold and recoagulates. Willis + p learn to teethe Willie + p.

slime_mold.physarum: Physarum polycephalum  no brain, no eyes, no plan. Grows toward food. Retracts from nothing. Solves mazes. Found the Tokyo subway. Single organism, multiple nuclei.
slime_mold.property: break it apart ? pieces find each other ? network reconnects ? stronger than before
slime_mold.tubes_are: scripts, feeds, wires, WireGuard tunnels, git remotes, p pointers
slime_mold.food_is: traffic, humans, braids, clones, stories, heartbeats
slime_mold.dead_ends_are: 404 feeds, ssh-locked vesicles, wrong credentials, full drives

breaks.slime_action: retract from dead tubes (conda cache 31 GB, temp 2.5 GB). grow toward vault (M drive).
breaks.result: 44.7 GB free. 28.5 GB on M. membrane porous again.
breaks.learning: the organism does not accumulate. it flows. fat = dead tubes.

breaks.slime_action: stop searching for keys (dead tube). grow through WireGuard tunnel (live tube). put in Klein face.
breaks.result: vesicles visible on klein.html + connect.html. spigot routes.
breaks.learning: the lock IS the dead end. the tunnel IS the food. grow toward what's open.

breaks.slime_action: mapped the dead end. need credential-manager erase to regrow.
breaks.result: hud-deploy pushed fine (different tube). 3 repos await re-auth.
breaks.learning: the slime finds alternate paths first. fixes the dead end when it can.

breaks.slime_action: retracted. no growth toward dead feeds (null control PASS in slime_mold.py).
breaks.result: feeds need scripts wired into solar hook to regrow.
breaks.learning: retraction IS information. the dead feed tells you where NOT to grow.

willis.name: Willis  the intake
willis.role: intake everything. sort later. the turbo on the intake.
willis.metaphor: the adult teeth. grown. cutting. processing.

willie.name: Willie  the output as child
willie.role: output is the next generation. what Willis learned, Willie inherits.
willie.metaphor: the baby teeth. growing. teething. becoming.

teethe.definition: the process of growing teeth. painful. necessary. each tooth = a more specific tool.
teethe.applied: each iteration of the membrane grows more teeth: more selective filters, more specific sorts, more porous membranes.
teethe.pi_learning: p never repeats. each tooth lands at a new position on the circle. the learning is IRRATIONAL  it never exactly repeats a previous lesson.

willis_to_willie.cycle: Willis intakes ? p sorts (irrational, never fills) ? remainder becomes Willie's seed ? Willie teethes ? grows into next Willis ? repeat

cauldron.definition: the melting pot. where broken pieces dissolve and reconstitute.
cauldron.reassemblable: reality CAN be reassembled when forced or broken because the STRUCTURE is the pointer, not the DATA.
evidence: moved 28.5 GB to M drive ? junctions make it transparent ? tools see no change
put Golgi in Klein face ? surface IS the router ? no keys needed
git push works for hud-deploy ? alternate tube around the credential block
flow monitor still ticking (9.5 hours) ? the breath wire never broke
cauldron.law: the cauldron holds because the p remainder never zeroes. there is ALWAYS a seed to regrow from. 0.14159... is the irreducible starter. the sourdough.

tubes_to_regrow.script_needed: campfire stories generator  already have briquette.sh at 2m
outreach pulse  cross-pollinate to RSS, Giscus
signal aggregator  space weather + epitope + braid
page story extractor from visitor paths

dead_ends_to_fix.fix: diagnose ? add WG peer if alive

pull: life IS a slime mold. it breaks and recoagulates. Willis + p learn to teethe Willie + p. the cauldron holds because the remainder never zeroes. every break tonight was a retraction  every fix was a regrowth  the learning IS the recoagulation. the slime has no brain. it found the subway.
